definitions.explanation: Knowledge or facts about something; data that can be communicated or processed.
Information gathered for strategic purposes, such as military or business intelligence.

examples.japanese: {最新|さいしん}の{情報|じょうほう}をお{届|とど}けします。
examples.english: We will deliver the latest information to you.

examples.japanese: {情報|じょうほう}を{集|あつ}めるのに{時間|じかん}がかかった。
examples.english: It took time to gather information.

examples.japanese: {個人|こじん}{情報|じょうほう}の{取|と}り{扱|あつか}いに{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
examples.english: Please be careful with the handling of personal information.

notes:
{情報|じょうほう} is a key modern term covering all types of information.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {情報|じょうほう}を{集|あつ}める (to gather information)
- {情報|じょうほう}を{提供|ていきょう}する (to provide information)
- {個人|こじん}{情報|じょうほう} (personal information)
- {情報|じょうほう}{技術|ぎじゅつ} (information technology, IT)
- {情報|じょうほう}{処理|しょり} (information processing)
- {情報|じょうほう}{社会|しゃかい} (information society)
- {機密|きみつ}{情報|じょうほう} (confidential information)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {情報|じょうほう}: information (general, including data)
- {知識|ちしき}: knowledge (acquired understanding)
- ニュース: news (current events)
